about.title: Digital marketing with a practical understanding of business
about.paragraph1: I’m Martha Karanja, a digital marketer based in Nairobi, Kenya. I work across SEO, paid search planning, content writing and email marketing, helping businesses communicate their offers clearly and reach the right audiences.
about.paragraph2: My work combines research, planning and content creation. The projects in this portfolio show how I approach keyword research, campaign preparation, website content and email communication.
about.paragraph3: I also founded Virtual Assistant Solutions, a consultancy providing fractional COO and operations support to founders and business owners in East Africa and internationally.
about.approachText: I begin by understanding the business, its customers and the purpose of the work. That context helps me research relevant search terms, write useful content and prepare marketing materials that communicate the offer clearly. My background in operations also gives me an appreciation of the systems, processes and customer interactions that support a business.
about.step1: I clarify the business objective, the intended audience and what the work needs to achieve.
about.step2: I use the brief to guide the research, messaging, content structure and deliverables.
about.step3: I develop the agreed work, check it for clarity and consistency, and present the finished deliverables for review.
